plan: chain plan v1: where the chain ball -> player on the ball -> team breaks, on the labelled actions of the existing shot clips
owner decisions: M7 / M9 used for development (seal lifted by the owner on 2026-11-05; openings still logged through src/unseal.py); the final test will be on the owner's own matches
data: the 223 shot clips of 9 matches in .cache/gpu_shots3 (M1 117092 left out: its truth boxes are in another pixel frame); our rows of metric_v3s_link.parquet (players and ball in pitch metres, player team labels); labelled actions of <unit>_events.csv with a player_id, frames 350-1075, at the even frame at or just before; truth players of <unit>_gt.parquet (x, y in metres, side)

per action, at its frame f.truth matching: our players to truth players at f by pitch distance, Hungarian, limit 2 m
per action, at its frame f.team map: per unit, team_A / team_B to left / right by the majority side among matched detections over the clip; 'other' or no label = no team
per action, at its frame f.S1 ball found: our ball row at the nearest even frame within f +- 4 frames, within 3 m of the action's position (x, y of the events file)
per action, at its frame f.S2 nearest player is the actor: given S1, our player nearest our ball is the detection matched to the actor
per action, at its frame f.S3 team given: given S2, that detection has team_A or team_B
per action, at its frame f.S4 team right: given S3, its mapped side is the action's side
per action, at its frame f.end to end: the mapped side of our player nearest our ball equals the action's side (the possession proxy; a teammate counts)

oracle swaps (each replaces one link by.ball: the action's position instead of our ball
oracle swaps (each replaces one link by.player: the detection matched to the actor instead of the one nearest our ball (fails if the actor is not detected)
oracle swaps (each replaces one link by.team: the truth side of the chosen detection (via matching) instead of its label (fails if unmatched)

reported: shares overall, per action kind (pass, carry, other), per match; bootstrap over matches (5,000, seed 0) for the end-to-end share and each swap's gain
reading rule: the swap with the largest end-to-end gain is the link to work on first; no other claim
